candidate.title: No host-conformance vector exercises an explicit `"kind":"zk"` allow or a `kind`-bearing deny, although both are normatively permitted
candidate.claim: The kind enum acceptance side is only covered for `classical` and `external` on `allow`. A host that whitelists only the two non-default classes (treating explicit `zk` as unrecognized), or that validates `kind` only on the allow branch (or rejects it on deny), passes all 29 vectors yet violates §3.3/§3.5. Two vectors close the coverage hole: `host-allow-well-behaved-kind-zk` (explicit `kind=zk` allow, exit 0, expected `allow`) and `host-relay-well-behaved-deny-kind-classical` (schema-valid `deny code=expired` carrying `kind=classical`, expected relayed deny with the verifier's code, not a host `schema_invalid` override).
evidence: spec/external-verifier-contract-v1.md §3.3 (pinned 9bf754441ab36ab93992ed5936d34c44a4128f92): "`kind` ... It **MAY** appear on either an `allow` or a `deny` verdict."
spec/external-verifier-contract-v1.md §3.5: "A `zk`-class verifier **MAY** therefore omit the field; emitting `"kind":"zk"` explicitly is equivalent for a revision-aware host."

Conformance vector index (set 0.7.0, 29 vectors): the only kind-acceptance vectors are `host-allow-well-behaved-kind-classical` and `host-allow-well-behaved-kind-external`; `host-relay-well-behaved-deny` is a bare deny with no `kind`; `host-deny-bad-kind` covers only the rejection side on `allow`.

Reproduce: `grep -l '"kind"' spec/fixtures/host-conformance/*.json` at the pinned commit returns only the bad-kind, kind-classical and kind-external fixtures — no fixture contains `"kind":"zk"` and no deny fixture contains `kind`.
candidate.proposed_artifact: Two new host_behavior vectors (`host-allow-well-behaved-kind-zk`, `host-relay-well-behaved-deny-kind-classical`) in spec/fixtures/host-conformance/ with expected outcomes, staged as a diff pinned to 9bf7544 plus the sync.js/golden regeneration note.

score.reason: Both missing acceptance controls are confirmed in the actual JavaScript fixtures and test-vectors.json, although the candidate's fixture JSON glob is incorrect.
